description: Pay-per-call: 25 free/day then $0.001 USDC via x402. Email address check WITHOUT sending mail or SMTP probing: RFC-style syntax check, domain MX/A records via DNS-over-HTTPS, disposable-domain flag (CC0 blocklist, ~9,900 domains), role-address flag (info@, support@...), free-mail flag. Verdict: deliverable_domain | risky | invalid. Cannot confirm that the mailbox itself exists. Addresses are not stored or logged. Calling this tool returns the HTTP request and x402 payment requirements (or use the free quota).
name: email_verify
